a.lede: Amazon is rumored to be making a smartphone, and the Alexa-powered experiences on its new tablets give us a taste of what might come if that happens.
a.title: The New Alexa Tablets Feel Like a Blueprint for an Amazon Phone

b.lede: The lineup includes three models: Amazon Alexa Tablet 12 Pro, Amazon Alexa Tablet 11, and Amazon Alexa Tablet 8.
b.title: Amazon unveils new Alexa tablets with Alexa+ and Google Play Store access
